mental_profile.notes: Chinese state media (Global Times) profile headline explicitly frames him as 'a star in the making' who 'keeps feet on ground amid high expectations', a publicly documented characterization of his temperament.

off_pitch.commercial_profile: Subject of a dedicated Global Times feature and a Chinese U21 Golden Boy award, indicating significant domestic media profile for a teenage player.

data_quality.notes: Born 23 Nov 2006 in Ningbo, Zhejiang. Signed with Zhejiang FC in July 2023. Called up to China's U20 squad in Jan 2025, scoring in all three pre-Asian Cup friendlies (vs Korea Yonsei University, Bangkok United U23, Uzbekistan U20). Scored his first senior national-team goal via a decisive penalty in a June 2025 FIFA World Cup Asian qualifier vs Bahrain at 18 years 199 days, reported as China's youngest-ever scorer in such a match and the first player born after 2005 to reach the senior team. Named the 2025 Chinese Super League's Best Young Player (award given 12/15 Dec 2025 per China Daily). Also referenced as a 'Chinese U21 Golden Boy' winner in a separate general search snippet.
